# Text modifiers

> Generated from the source doc comments. Do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `cargo run -p choscorui-api-docs --locked`. The [index](README.md) lists every item. Every example assumes `use choscorui::prelude::*;`.

## Text modifiers

### `font_weight`

```rust
fn font_weight<M>(self, weight: impl IntoLive<FontWeight, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The font weight of text in the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let label = Text::new("Total").font_weight(FontWeight::BOLD);
```

### `locale`

```rust
fn locale<M>(self, locale: impl IntoLive<Locale, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The locale of the view's text, and its layout direction.

#### Examples

```rust
let locale = Locale::parse("vi").unwrap_or_else(|_| Locale::root());
let page = Text::new("Hello").locale(locale);
```

### `text_style`

```rust
fn text_style<M>(self, preset: impl IntoLive<TextPreset, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The text preset of text in the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let heading = Text::new("Settings").text_style(TextPreset::H2);
```

### `tracking`

```rust
fn tracking<M>(self, tracking: impl IntoLive<Tracking, M>) -> Styled<Self>
```

The letter spacing of text in the view.

#### Examples

```rust
let caps = Text::new("NEW").tracking(Tracking::Wide);
```
